$comment: Shared phase-grouping cases, read by BOTH frontend/src/views/roadmap.test.ts and
backend/tests/test_roadmap.py. The rule is implemented twice — once in TypeScript
for the results view, once in Python for the PDF — because the two runtimes cannot
share code. This file is what stops those two copies drifting: a case added here
must pass in both suites, so a change to one implementation and not the other is a
test failure rather than a report that quietly disagrees with the screen.
`expect` is the phase each finding must land in.

cases.name: high effort is structural whatever else it says

finding.title: Single-AZ deployment
finding.remediation: Move the database to a multi-AZ deployment.

cases.name: more than one affected component is structural even at low effort

finding.title: Traffic between tiers is unencrypted
finding.remediation: Terminate TLS at the load balancer and require TLS on both hops.

cases.name: low effort AND high severity on one component is immediate

finding.title: S3 bucket has no default encryption
finding.remediation: Enable SSE-KMS as the bucket default.

cases.name: low effort on a component-less finding is still immediate at high severity

finding.title: No model-usage policy referenced
finding.remediation: State the approved model list in the design document.

cases.name: cheap but not urgent is short-term, not immediate

finding.title: No cost allocation tags
finding.remediation: Apply the standard cost allocation tag set.

cases.name: medium effort is short-term even at high severity

finding.title: Secrets are passed as environment variables
finding.remediation: Read secrets from Secrets Manager at start-up.

cases.name: no effort recorded: high severity on one component falls back to immediate
no effort recorded: medium severity falls back to short-term
no effort recorded: several components is still structural
an Operational Excellence document fix is NOT forced to structural by pillar

finding.title: No deployment rollback procedure described
finding.remediation: Describe the rollback procedure in the design document.

cases.name: a Reliability finding that is genuinely cheap stays immediate

finding.title: Health check interval not specified
finding.remediation: Set the target group health check interval to 10 seconds.

excluded.name: a passing check is not on the roadmap

finding.title: IAM roles are scoped per service

excluded.name: a not-applicable check is not on the roadmap
